products.name: Replicate
products.note: Model hosting and inference API; open-source models; community models; content policy

profile_text.body:
Replicate is a cloud platform that lets developers run open-source machine learning models through an API. The company describes itself as a way for businesses to deploy AI features quickly and scale to large user bases without requiring in-house machine learning expertise, handling infrastructure concerns such as API servers, GPU provisioning, model weights, CUDA dependencies, and batching on the customer's behalf.

The platform hosts a range of models from third parties, including image generation models from OpenAI and Krea, and a coding and reasoning model from Anthropic. Beyond hosted models, Replicate offers Cog, an open-source tool for packaging custom machine learning models so that developers can deploy their own code to the platform. Users can also fine-tune models and access metrics and logs for monitoring and debugging predictions.

The site's held facts record Replicate's primary product as a model hosting and inference API covering open-source and community models, with a noted content policy in place. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations appear in the available data.
